items.title: Paneer Butter Masala
items.description: Tender cubes of fresh cottage cheese simmered in a velvety, rich tomato, butter, and cashew gravy infused with fragrant fenugreek leaves.

items.title: Hyderabadi Veg Dum Biryani
items.description: Layered long-grain basmati rice with marinated seasonal vegetables, aromatic spices, fresh mint, and saffron steam-cooked in authentic 'Dum' style. Served with Mirchi Ka Salan & Cucumber Raita.

items.title: Vegetable Samosas (20 / 40 pcs)
items.description: Handcrafted flaky, crisp golden pastry generously stuffed with spiced potatoes, green peas, cumin, and coriander seeds. Served with sweet tamarind and zesty mint chutneys.

items.title: Palak Paneer
items.description: Soft cottage cheese cubes cooked in a vibrant, spiced fresh spinach gravy finished with a touch of fresh cream and roasted cumin.

items.title: Dal Makhani
items.description: Slow-simmered whole black lentils and kidney beans cooked overnight with butter, rich cream, and delicate spices for an unmatched creamy texture.

items.title: Paneer Tikka (Tandoori Style)
items.description: Fresh paneer cubes, bell peppers, and red onions marinated in hung yogurt, ajwain, and aromatic tandoori masala, roasted to perfection.

items.title: Hara Bhara Kabab (20 / 40 pcs)
items.description: Nutritious and delicious patties made with minced spinach, green peas, potatoes, paneer, and mild green chilies, shallow fried to a delicate crisp.

items.title: Shahi Malai Kofta
items.description: Hand-rolled melt-in-the-mouth paneer and potato dumplings filled with dry fruits, served in a luxurious mildly sweet cashew-cream gravy.

items.title: Chana Masala (Punjabi Style)
items.description: Tender chickpeas simmered in a robust, homestyle gravy of roasted spices, pomegranate seeds, ginger, and fresh cilantro. Pairs wonderfully with Bhature or Rice.

items.title: Jeera Rice (Basmati)
items.description: Fluffy, fragrant aged basmati rice tempered with whole cumin seeds (jeera) and pure ghee, garnished with fresh chopped coriander.

items.title: South Indian Curd Rice
items.description: Traditional comfort rice mixed with fresh creamy homemade yogurt, tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger, green chilies, and topped with pomegranate pearls.

items.title: Fresh Garlic Naan (15 / 30 pcs)
items.description: Leavened oven-baked flatbread topped with minced roasted garlic, fresh cilantro, and brushed with melted butter.

items.title: Homestyle Soft Phulkas / Rotis (20 / 40 pcs)
items.description: Fresh whole wheat flatbreads hand-rolled and puffed on an open flame, lightly brushed with pure desi ghee (or vegan oil upon request).

items.title: Traditional Gulab Jamun (25 / 50 pcs)
items.description: Classic sweet fried dumplings prepared with milk solids (khoya), dipped in warm aromatic sugar syrup flavored with green cardamom and rose water.

items.title: Royal Kesar Rasmalai (20 / 40 pcs)
items.description: Pillowy soft cottage cheese patties soaked in luscious thickened saffron-infused milk (rabdi) and garnished with slivered pistachios and almonds.

items.title: Gajar Ka Halwa
items.description: Rich traditional Punjabi dessert made with slow-cooked shredded carrots, reduced milk, pure desi ghee, sugar, and crunchy cashew nuts.

items.title: Pooja & Housewarming Special Combo
items.description: Complete auspicious feast: Samosa starter, Paneer Butter Masala, Chana Masala or Dal, Veg Pulao, Fresh Phulkas (30 pcs), Boondi Raita, Salad & Gulab Jamun.

items.title: Grand Birthday & Celebration Feast
items.description: Party delight: 2 Starters (Paneer Tikka & Hara Bhara Kabab), Hyderabadi Veg Dum Biryani, Dal Makhani, Paneer Curry, Butter Naan (25 pcs), Salan, Raita & Rasmalai.
